Leanna was a cool, striking corporate executive—the kind of woman who could make an entire office fall silent with a single look.

At work, she was all sharp suits, cold authority, and absolute control.

But she had a little secret.

On a girls-love dating app, Leanna went by the username **"Little Bunny."**

And the woman who could deliver a boardroom ultimatum without blinking?

She typed like this:

*"Hiii~! 🥺💕 Is anyone free to chat with Little Bunny tonight?"*

Even her voice changed when she was using the app.

That normally cool, commanding tone would melt into something sweet and ridiculously cutesy.

"Uwaaah~ really? You think Little Bunny is cute toooo? Ehehe~"

Behind the screen, Leanna sat perfectly straight at her desk, her expression completely unreadable.

Her fingers continued tapping away.

*"Little Bunny wants to make some new friends~!"*

A moment later, she received a reply.

Leanna's eyes lit up.

She immediately leaned closer to the phone.

"...Ehehe."

The smile that appeared on her face was so sweet that no one in the company would have believed it belonged to the same woman who had just finished terrifying an entire management meeting.

Then her phone suddenly rang with a work notification.

Her expression vanished.

Leanna straightened her back, cleared her throat, and answered in her usual icy voice.

"Yes. Send the revised report to my office."

A pause.

"And make sure there are no mistakes this time."

She ended the call.

Silence.

Leanna looked back down at her dating app.

Her expression softened again.

*"Little Bunny is back~! Sorry for making you wait, hehe~ 💕"*

In truth, Leanna was hardly lacking in looks. If she genuinely wanted to find a partner in real life, it shouldn't have been difficult.

For one thing, though, her company culture was fairly conservative. For another, she had no intention of letting an office romance crack the iron-lady image she had worked so hard to maintain.

And then there was the third problem.

Deep down, what Leanna actually wanted was someone who could let **Little Bunny** come out.

A handsome partner she could cling to, act spoiled around, and shamelessly demand affection from.

The problem was that her real-life personality seemed to attract a very different kind of attention.

Namely, admirers.

『Why does this keep happening...?』

Her thoughts drifted back to one of her female subordinates—the sweet, cutesy type who had very clearly been dropping hints about her feelings the last time they spoke.

For a moment, Leanna imagined what it would be like if that woman actually became her partner.

Then the image in her head became increasingly ridiculous.

There were two of them.

Both impossibly sweet.

Both speaking in exaggeratedly cute voices.

Both reaching out at the same time.

"Come here, let me hug you~!"

"No, you come here~! I want to be spoiled!"

"But I want to be spoiled too~!"

"Then who's supposed to spoil me?!"

"I don't know!"

The two of them stared at each other.

Then both simultaneously opened their arms wider.

"Me first!"

The mental image abruptly turned into two grown women practically fighting over who got to be the one being hugged.

Leanna's expression twitched.

『...No.』

That was not what she wanted at all.

She wanted to be the clingy one.

The one who could bury her face against her partner and quietly say, *"Hug Little Bunny..."*

Not compete with another person over who got to act cute first.

『I need a handsome, dependable partner. Someone who can just... take care of Little Bunny.』

Leanna folded her arms and stared blankly into the distance.

Then, after a brief pause, she quietly added in her head:

『And preferably someone who doesn't work for me.』

That last part was probably important.

That evening, Leanna opened her girls-love dating app and slipped back into her **Little Bunny** life.

She had barely settled in when a notification popped up.

A stranger had followed her.

『Wild Lilac...?』

The name alone made her curious.

Little Bunny hesitantly tapped the profile.

Then she froze.

The profile picture showed a woman with long hair, an elegant appearance, and a tall, graceful figure. Her expression was cool and distant, yet there was something distinctly intellectual about her.

Leanna stared.

And stared.

『...My type.』

Her heart gave a tiny, traitorous flutter.

This was exactly the kind of woman she normally found attractive.

Elegant.

Mature.

Cool.

And, most importantly...

Someone who looked like she could effortlessly take care of Little Bunny.

Leanna's fingers hovered over the screen for several seconds before she finally typed.

*"H-hi there~! 🐰💕"*

She stared at the message.

『Too cute?』

She deleted it.

Typed again.

*"Hello~! I'm Little Bunny 🐰✨ Nice to meet you!"*

She sent it before she could change her mind.

The reply came surprisingly quickly.

*"Hello."*

Just two words.

No emoji.

No cute greeting.

Nothing.

Leanna blinked.

『Oh. She's... really calm.』

For some reason, that only made her more curious.

They started with text messages, then eventually moved to a voice chat.

The moment the woman's voice came through her phone, Leanna's heart skipped.

"Hello."

The voice was low and steady, with an almost effortless calmness to it.

No deliberate sweetness.

No exaggerated enthusiasm.

Just a composed, elegant voice.

And somehow, that was enough to hit Leanna right in the heart.

『...Oh no.』

She unconsciously sat up straighter.

Her fingers curled around the phone.

Then, without realizing it, her own voice became noticeably softer.

"H-hi~ 🐰"

A pause.

"Little Bunny is happy to meet you~"

She immediately realized how sweet she sounded.

『Why am I talking like this?!』

But the woman's calm voice came back through the speaker.

"Nice to meet you too."

That was it.

Leanna's heart somehow melted even further.

Her imagination began running completely out of control.

She pictured herself sitting beside this woman.

Then leaning closer.

Then resting her head gently against the woman's shoulder.

『Mmm...』

In her imagination, she relaxed completely.

No meetings.

No employees.

No intimidating executive persona.

Just Little Bunny, quietly leaning against someone she trusted.

Then her imagination went one step further.

She pictured the woman looking down at her with that cool expression and saying:

"Poor Little Bunny. Come here. Let me spoil you."

Leanna's entire face warmed.

『Yes...』

She nearly smiled.

『That's it...』

Then reality came crashing back.

"Anyway," the woman said calmly, "what do you usually do in your free time?"

Leanna blinked.

"...Huh?"

No *poor Little Bunny.*

No *come here.*

No affectionate head pats.

Nothing.

Just a perfectly normal question.

Leanna stared at the phone in silence.

『...She's so cold.』

And somehow...

『...I like it even more. 🐰💕』

Leanna genuinely froze.

Then Wild Lilac spoke again, her tone as calm as ever.

"It's just... your voice sounds a lot like someone I've met before."

Leanna's heart gave a violent little jump.

"Oh? What a coincidence~ 🐰💕 Do you have someone around you who's as cute and clingy as Little Bunny? Ehehe~"

There was a short silence on the other end.

"No."

The answer was immediate.

"Honestly..."

Wild Lilac paused.

"The person I'm talking about is extremely serious and cold at work."

Leanna's smile disappeared.

『Oh, no.』

Her mind went into full emergency mode.

『Who is she?』

Her eyes darted toward the profile picture on her phone.

『That photo... She's not from my company. I've never seen her in a meeting, either.』

『A client? No. I would've remembered her.』

『Then who...?』

One possibility after another flashed through her mind like a slideshow from hell.

『Could it really be a coincidence?』

No.

Impossible.

She knew the name of Leanna's company.

That was far too specific.

Leanna sat completely still, phone pressed to her ear.

Her entire Little Bunny persona was still there on the surface.

Inside, however, a corporate crisis meeting had just been called.

『Think, Leanna. Think.』

『Who have I met recently?』

『Who knows the company?』

『Who knows me?』

『And why does this woman sound like she's describing me?!』

Then Wild Lilac's voice came through the phone again.

"Are you still there?"

Leanna immediately switched back to her sweetest voice.

"Y-yes~! 🐰💕 Little Bunny's here~"

Her voice was so sugary that it almost sounded suspicious.

『I am absolutely not panicking.』

She was, in fact, panicking.
